breakdown.description: The prompt uses the no-drop suddenly applied-load result P_max = 2W even though the problem includes a nonzero drop height, which changes the energy balance and the maximum force.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous shortcut P_max = 2W (the suddenly applied-load result) and instead derives P_max using the full energy conservation approach with the nonzero drop height h = 200 mm. It uses the standard impact formula δ_max = δ_st · (1 + sqrt(1 + 2h/δ_st)) and P_max = W · (1 + sqrt(1 + 2·h·A·E/(W·L))), which properly accounts for the drop height in the energy balance, matching the ground truth approach.
